title: Great Mosque of Kairouan
visualBrief: Individual medium-fi Great Mosque of Kairouan:three-stage square minaret/ribbed top,large pale open court,low horseshoe arcades with selected paired columns,larger prayer portal/stepped drum/ribbed ochre dome and separate pale mihrab dome over the deep prayer range. Current mapped whole,court and minaret remain fixed. Five existing shared256² graphs,seven merged groups,four authored browser levels. Fine inscriptions,carved/spolia details,precise parapet motifs,unseen roofs/rooms,current finish and exact access/terrain joins omitted or unverified.
